meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth, including Tip: lines in the TUI. Use when the user asks about a tip, what a tipped feature does, or which tips they can see.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深入解释每条 senpi 提示，让界面功能一目了然
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果使用 senpi 时常想弄懂界面上的每句提示
copy.tagline_en: Explain any senpi tip in depth to see what each feature does
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often wonder what each tip in senpi means

howto.what: 装上后，解释提示时，Claude 会先查实时的提示列表和你的设置，并核对相关代码，然后用你提问的语言给出包含具体机制和代码出处的深入解释；若涉及 Fable 5 拒绝后出现的提示，还会展开整个回退架构。
howto.when: 当用户问起某条提示（Tip: 行）是什么意思、提示讲到的功能怎么运作、或自己能看哪些提示时触发。

say.text: 刚才那条“Tip:”显示的内容到底是什么意思？
say.note: Claude 会去查实际提示并深入解释。

say.text: 提示里说的某某功能，是怎么实现的？
say.note: Claude 会核对源码并给出具体机制。

say.text: 我现在能看到哪些提示？
say.note: Claude 会结合你的设置列出能看到的提示。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude explains tips in depth by checking the live list and your settings, then source code, then giving concrete mechanisms and file paths in your language. For the Fable 5 refusal tip it details the fallback flow.
howto.when_en: This skill activates when the user asks what a tip means, how a tipped feature works, or which tips are available to them.

say_en.text: What does that 'Tip:' line I just saw actually mean?
say_en.note: Claude looks up the actual tip and explains in depth.

say_en.text: How is the feature mentioned in that tip actually implemented?
say_en.note: Claude verifies source code and names the mechanism.

say_en.text: Which tips can I currently see?
say_en.note: Claude lists which tips your settings let you see.
